extras: Potential shortcut conflicts with other plugins using Cmd/Ctrl + Enter.
intentEvidence: 本插件正是基于这一理念设计：用最简单的方式记录任务的开始时间和耗时
motivation: The author built it based on the philosophy of Alexander Lyubishchev to help users build awareness of their time usage and discover patterns.
problem: Users need a simple way to objectively record and track the actual time spent on tasks without complex planning or systems.

relations.evidence: 如果你安装了其他使用 Cmd+Enter 的插件（如 logseq-todo-compatibility），可能会有冲突。

summary: A time tracking plugin that automatically calculates and records the duration spent on tasks using Markdown checkboxes and keyboard shortcuts.
